title: EvidenceReference
description: Lightweight reference to evidence owned by a Specialist OS. The authoritative evidence remains in the owning system. Do NOT create a shared evidence database.

evidenceId.description: Unique identifier for this evidence reference.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID linking to the business/delivery flow.

ownerSystem.description: Specialist OS that owns the authoritative evidence.

reference.description: System-internal URI or identifier for retrieving the evidence (e.g., ic://evidences/test-run-abc123).

digest.description: Content digest for integrity verification of the referenced evidence.

summary.description: Brief human-readable summary of the evidence.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the evidence was created.
